pages.title: Food Tooltips
pages.text:
Hover over any food item to see Nourished tooltip information below the item name:

$(bold)Food Group$() — which bar this food fills.
$(bold)Nutrition Value$() — how much it fills the bar under ideal conditions.
$(bold)Food Family$() — which family it belongs to for diminishing returns.
$(bold)Freshness$() — whether this food currently gives full, reduced, or bonus nutrition.

pages.title: Freshness Indicator
pages.text:
The $(#52c252)freshness indicator$() tells you how much nutrition you will actually receive:

$(#52c252)Fresh$() — first time eating this food today; full or bonus nutrition.
$(#E8C24F)Reduced$() — diminishing returns active; lower nutrition than base.
$(#e05252)Saturated$() — heavily repeated; minimal nutrition gain.

If a food shows Saturated, switch to a different family within that group for better returns.

pages.title: Streak Warning
pages.text:
When the streak penalty is active, the tooltip shows a $(#e05252)streak counter$(). This appears after eating the same food consecutively without switching.

If you see this, eat one different food before continuing with your usual diet. Even a single item from a different food family resets the streak and restores full multipliers.

pages.title: JEI Tag Search
pages.text:
If you have JEI installed, you can filter the entire item list by food group. Type any of these into the JEI search bar:

$(bold)nourished:nutrients/fruits$()
$(bold)nourished:nutrients/vegetables$()
$(bold)nourished:nutrients/proteins$()
$(bold)nourished:nutrients/grains$()
$(bold)nourished:nutrients/dairy$()

pages.title: JEI Tag Search (cont.)
pages.text:
This is the fastest way to answer the question $(bold)"what can I eat right now?"$() when a bar is low.

JEI will show every item on the server assigned to that group — including modded foods — so you can see at a glance what you have in your inventory or nearby chests that qualifies.

pages.title: Unrecognized Foods
pages.text:
If a food item shows $(bold)Unclassified$() or no Nourished tooltip at all, it has not been assigned to a food group on this server.

For modded foods this is usually resolved by the server's datapack configuration. If you believe a food should belong to a specific group, contact your server admin or check the Nourished datapack documentation in the $(bold)Server Owners$() chapter.
